synopsis: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

title: Maria the Virgin Witch
synopsis: As a war to determine the rightful ruler of medieval France ravages the land, it seems that the only hope for most, is protection from the heavens above through prayer. But deep in the forest outside of a small, bucolic village, the witch Maria will not stand idly by as men kill each other and commit horrendous acts in the name of God and glory. Using her powerful magic, she'll summon various beasts and demons—even going as far as using a succubus to seduce soldiers into submission under the veil of night—all to stop the needless slaughter. However, Maria's display of her magical might has drawn the ire of the Kingdom of Heaven and after the Archangel Michael puts an end to her meddling, he curses her to lose her powers if she ever gives up her virginity. Will she forgo the forbidden fruit of adulthood in order to bring an end to the merciless machine of war? (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: 7th
synopsis: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family? (Source: J-Novel Club)
